The issuer shows solid liquidity with a current ratio of 2.29 and a decent operating profitability profile (EBIT of 811M on 5,633M revenue, ~14% margin). Leverage appears moderate (total liabilities of 27,401M versus total assets of 58,167M), and positive retained earnings support ongoing financial resilience, but there isn’t enough evidence here of very strong, stable credit metrics (e.g., interest coverage) to rate above the investment-grade threshold.

DECISION: BBB+
